classification.notes: Effort: Steady slicing plus marinade (1); short sauté then covered simmer (1); stew plus rice (1); layer-and-simmer technique (0); rice is set-and-forget so coordination 0 (same as coconut curry / thai basil precedent). Marinade plus coconut stew build (1). Sum 2 -> standard. Brazilian cuisine adds no points.
